verdict.reasons: The commercial roll is the correct upright white-and-blue AFP carton, with readable brand captions and authentic localized text. Wheat row, thin flat drip-tape lateral, and root-zone wetting align with agronomy intent. Watermark is present. Minor framing/soil texture variance only; no core defect.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP package is fully surrounded by a broad, uninterrupted gap of bare soil and the adjacent darker irrigation trench on all visible sides, including the front base and the gap between the carton and the installed dark lateral line. No irrigation line touches, crosses under, emerges from, or reappears behind the package on the same axis; the visible lateral runs entirely in the separate trench to the right. The required package is the only product object present, and no distinct additional loose coil or uninstalled roll is visible outside it. The sides and base of the carton show no protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tail.
